reason: Internal only; the Instagram social client is still not wired into composition (P5), so nothing a member of a room can observe changes. InstagramSocialClient is rewritten to the instagram-bridge's real contract: story is GET /accounts/{igid}/story (found true -> ok, found false -> nothing_found), profile is GET /accounts/{igid} (the handler's own 404 -> nothing_found), 409/503 and everything else -> unavailable; the old POST /social/story and its status envelope, which the bridge never had, are gone. Profile is newly served, rendered from the curated fields into the same untrusted wrap and clamp as story, and says when the bio/privacy half could not be read. posts stays unserved. The igid is shape-checked before it enters a URL path. Shared contract fixtures in tests/fixtures/instagram_bridge are generated by the Go handlers (deploy/instagram-bridge/contract_fixtures_test.go, -update) and read by the Python tests, so a shape change on either side fails on both. All fixture values are synthetic.
